Garib-E-Newaz, Advocate instructed by A.K.M. Shahidul Huq, Advocate-on-Record ------ For the Petitioners

Kadbanu Bibi and others ------ Petitioners
Vs.
Wazed Ali Sikder and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment:
3. The facts relevant for the purpose of disposal of the instant petition are that the respondent No.1 hereof as plaintiff filed the suit against the petitioner, as principal Defendant, and others contending, amongst others, that the schedule property in the suit belonged to petitioner No.1 hereof, who entered into an agreement for sale of the same to the plaintiff respondent hereof on 20.03.1989 on receipt of Tk.1200/- as advance out of the consideration money and the possession was also delivered and thereafter on receipt of the balance of the consideration amount on 14.04.1985 required sale deed was duly executed and registered and accordingly the plaintiff got his name mutated in the records of right and have been paying the land revenue to the Government and that on or about 08.04.1990 the plaintiff came to know that the defendant petitioner No.1 hereof filed Title Suit No.76 of 1989 without adding the plaintiff-respondent No.1 hereof as a party in the suit and accordingly the plaintiff filed an application for adding him as a defendant in the suit, which was rejected on 09.04.1990 upon hearing the parties, and that on the same day a sole-decree was passed in Title Suit No.76 of 1989 on the basis of a compromise petition. The defendant No.1-petitioner hereof claimed that he got the suit land by way of gift vide a registered heba-bil-ewaj deed dated 10.12.1981 from his minor son but the said minor son transferred the suit property along with other properties to the plaintiff prior to execution of the said heba deed and thus the heba deed was fraudulent, collusive and void document also being made without consideration and therefore the said son could not subsequently inherit the suit property from his mother the defendant No.1, after her death, and that the decree in Title Suit No.76 of 1989 was obtained on the basis of a solenama and that too by practicing fraud upon the Court and therefore the impugned decree is void, illegal, without jurisdiction and liable to be cancelled. 

 4. The defendant No. 1 petitioner hereof contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint and contending, inter alia, that the suit property belonged to Azid Ali Bepari and that the defendant No.1 was the wife of Azid Ali Bepari and that the said Azid Ali Bepari gifted the suit land in favour of the defendant No.2, son of defendant No.1 on 10.12.1981, who at the relevant time was a minor and delivery of possession was received by the defendant No.1 on behalf of her minor son, the defendant No.2, and accordingly they were enjoying usufructs from the suit land on payment land revenue and that Me gift was genuine and that there was no act of fraud in the transfer through the heba deed and that the defendant No.2 filed Title Suit No.547 of 1983 for setting aside the heba deed and that by suppressing the service of summons of the case and playing fraud upon the Court obtained an exparte decree against the defendant No.1 on 09.06.1986 and that thereafter for setting aside the said exparte decree the defendant No.1 as plaintiff filed Title Suit No.76 of 1989 and that the defendant No.1 though entered into a 2nd marriage yet used to visit her first husband's house regularly and she I possessed the suit property along with other properties through her brothers. Azid Ali Bepari being defendant No.1 in the said suit (Title Suit No.76 of 1989) filed a solenama and accordingly the Title Suit No.76 of 1989 was decreed on the basis of said solenama setting aside the decree passed in Title Suit No.547 of 1983 and that the plaintiff was not made a party in. said Title Suit No.76 of 1989 and that the defendant No.2 denied to have entered into any agreement with the plaintiff or executed any bainapatra in respect of the said property and that the possession of suit property was never handed over to the plaintiff and that the sale deed dated; 14.04.1985 is a collusive, void, anti dated and illegal one and that the bainapatra dated 20.03.1980 was a created document I to undo the heba deed dated 10.12.1981.
